Her eyes burned with drive. She had the ambition and flexibility
to ask others for feedback in order to produce results. The foundation for growth was well and truly there...!

Dantsu Flame's running had some sluggishness during acceleration,
and honestly, she didn't show any standout talent at the moment. However—

Huh...? A-Are you sure...!?
Trainer, aren't you still looking for a trainee Umamusume—

Y-Yes! I'd love to!
I'll be in your care...!

...It was through such a small, trivial encounter
that Dantsu Flame and I began talking—

...Ahaha. Sorry for just walking up and talking to you out of nowhere.
I'm Dantsu Flame.

And so, until the Debut Showcase Race,
my days of overseeing Dantsu Flame's training began—

Number 7 suddenly makes a burst for the front! What incredible speed!
The trailing pack gives chase! Will they catch up in time!?

Trainer...!
Um, I...

Wait, really!?
Yay! ...!

Ehehe...
...But right now, I don't feel like I've got it down, and it's troubling me.
Right! —Hyaaaah!!

At first, I thought she was like a gentle patch of sunlight.
...Yes, that's what I thought.

She can run. She's an Umamusume who can turn effort into results.
Even if she can't win right now, I want to support her growth...!

Huh—... Whaaat!? B-But I just lost, you know...!?
So why are you scouting me...!?

As I continued watching her earnest dedication,
a certain feeling welled up within me as a Trainer—

—I-I accept! Your scout offer!
I want to sign a contract with you, Trainer!

Ah, yes. ...Actually, I got selected to run in the Debut Showcase Race.
So I was doing some tune-ups for that.

...Um, if you have some time, that is...
Could you maybe watch my running...?

As the days went by, whenever we ran into each other,
we began greeting and talking with one another—

Yes!
Keep the rhythm... don't let my core wobble...!

R-Really? Yay...!
I'll stay mindful of that for the final stretch too!

Ah...! S-Sorry! Wait, are those...
the "Farm-Fresh Triple Milk Donuts"... !?

Ah, is that so!
Thank you for your hard work. Best of luck!

Ehehe! I surprised myself, too—
...Trainer, are you heading out somewhere after this?

Alongside that sunny smile of hers,
my days of taking on challenges with Dantsu Flame had begun... or so I thought—

...Um. I'm still nowhere near being the star of the show...
but even so... I look forward to working with you!

Amazing...! Um, where did you buy them?
I really wanted some, but couldn't find any at the school store...!

...I'm truly so happy.
I mean... I never thought anyone would scout me after I lost—

...Dantsu Flame couldn't catch up to Number 7, who had made the earlier move,
and suffered a narrow defeat in 2nd place. However, from my perspective—

Holding the lead! Crossing the finish line!!
The winner of today's Debut Showcase Race is—
Actually, today... I got a perfect score on my pop quiz in class!

Passing the 400m mark! Now begins the decisive battle,
who will be the one to make their move!?
————Haah... haah... haah...!

...Dantsu Flame eagerly completed the training regimen I devised every single day,
and her running was steadily, surely improving.
Haah... haah... haah...!

It was lunchtime. As I headed to the outdoor stage
to eat my lunch outside—

Phew...—
One last set...!

...One day, while watching the academy's track
and pondering recent training theories—
—And then, the day of the Debut Showcase Race finally arrived.

~♪ ~♪
—Ah, Trainer! ~.

Phew... Hmm, it just doesn't feel right... What should I do...?
—Huh? Trainer?
—Haah... haah... H-How... how was that?
